paths.description: Canonical single-page landing template reached through the requested-domain redirect; tested desktop/mobile, preferences, keyboard, performance, accessibility, network, security, images, and memory.
Raw HTML and JavaScript-disabled crawler comparison for the sole sitemap URL.
Primary LOGIN/DAFTAR hand-off checked through link inspection and HTTP reachability; external credentialed activity intentionally excluded.
Representative nonexistent canonical route to inspect HTTP/network failure recovery.

findings.summary: No system-driven dark theme
findings.evidence: Dark and default screenshots are materially identical, and the CSS feature probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: Continuous animation ignores reduced-motion
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched, three infinite animations (jalanTerus 15s, shineSlot 3s, pulseGlow 2s) remained running and no reduced-motion CSS was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential marquee, shine, and pulse animations inside prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: State changes lack platform transitions
findings.evidence: The page contains dismissible overlay and game state changes, but the CSS probe found no View Transition usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for meaningful overlay/game state changes, while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long page chrome is not scroll-state aware
findings.evidence: The page is 5,657px tall and has fixed header/footer chrome, but the CSS probe found no scroll timeline or scroll-state treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce or adapt persistent chrome after scrolling and provide position/progress feedback without scroll-event churn.

findings.summary: Load-time promotion obscures the page
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures show a full-screen dimming overlay and promotional card covering the primary content immediately on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not show the promotion on load; if retained, make it user-invoked, compact, and reliably light-dismissible.

findings.summary: Modal is an ad-hoc div with a keyboard-inaccessible close
findings.evidence: The overlay is #popupOverlay/#popupBox; its close is a plain span with tabIndex -1 and no role, not a dialog/button primitive.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal and a real <button> close control with focus trapping, Escape, and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Unrelated application chrome overwhelms the content
findings.evidence: The screenshot and DOM show a Mothercare-style fixed header, alphabet/product navigation, product controls, and fixed footer around a single gambling landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unrelated ecommerce chrome and keep only navigation that supports this page’s purpose.

findings.summary: Reusable cards rely only on viewport styling
findings.evidence: The page contains reusable promo/review/card components, but 206KB of inline CSS has no @container or container-type usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container queries where cards and navigation are reused at different inline sizes.

findings.summary: The modal cannot be dismissed by keyboard
findings.evidence: The visible close glyph is a span with tabIndex -1; focus probing also found many visible/focusable links with no visible outline or accessible name.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the close glyph with a sufficiently sized button and ensure every interactive item has a visible :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: Recovery states are missing or inaccessible
findings.evidence: The modal’s only close is not keyboard focusable, and a nonexistent route returns a bare 404 response with no actionable recovery body.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide accessible cancel/close controls and a useful 404 state with links back to safe primary paths.

findings.summary: Core Web Vitals are poor in lab evidence
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 10.5s and CLS 0.434, with 1,150ms TBT; the independent trace measured LCP 5.23s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset, reserve layout space, and reduce main-thread/network work until LCP and CLS reach good thresholds.

findings.summary: Late content causes major layout shift
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.434 and identified unsized images/layout-shift culprits; 27 of 56 images lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio on images and stabilise font fallbacks and injected content.

findings.summary: Script work blocks the main thread
findings.evidence: The trace recorded a 383ms long task and 339ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 1,150ms TBT and 14.3s time to interactive.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove irrelevant scripts, defer optional work, and split remaining long tasks.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is dominated by redirects and blocking third parties
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 190 requests, four parser-blocking stylesheets, non-deferred Klevu/product scripts, and a redirect from olxsts.com to olxoke.com.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the canonical page directly, self-host essential assets, defer non-critical scripts, and shorten the critical chain.

findings.summary: The landing page ships a full unrelated commerce bundle
findings.evidence: The HAR contains 129 scripts and 1.0MB script transfer, mostly Mothercare Magento modules; Lighthouse flags unused JS/CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Delete the copied commerce bundle and ship only code used by the landing page.

findings.summary: Many images and links lack accessible names
findings.evidence: axe reports critical image-alt and serious link-name violations; the image audit found 16 missing alt attributes and the DOM probe counted 125 empty links.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful controls and links accessible names and add meaningful alt text or presentation roles to images.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails WCAG AA
findings.evidence: axe measured ratios as low as 1.29:1 for yellow headings and 3.54:1 for review text.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose text/background tokens that meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.

findings.summary: Heading, landmark, and focus structure is inconsistent
findings.evidence: axe reports heading-order and region failures; the page has duplicate H1s and the modal close cannot receive keyboard focus.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page H1, sequential headings, complete landmarks, and managed modal focus.

findings.summary: Cross-origin assets and data calls fail at runtime
findings.evidence: Lighthouse records CORS-blocked customer-section fetches and font requests plus repeated ERR_FAILED console errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove foreign dependencies or serve them with correct CORS and handle request failures without console errors.

findings.summary: Image sizing and document asset hygiene are poor
findings.evidence: The image audit found 27 unsized, 15 oversized, and 40 legacy-format images; Lighthouse also reports incorrect image aspect ratio.
findings.suggestedFix: Set correct dimensions/aspect ratios and provide responsive modern image sources.

findings.summary: Deprecated and inspector-problematic code ships
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports a synchronous main-thread XMLHttpRequest deprecation, third-party-cookie inspector issue, and multiple failed resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove synchronous XHR, resolve inspector issues, and update or remove stale copied dependencies.

findings.summary: Meta description is missing
findings.evidence: The discoverability primitive found no meta description, and Lighthouse failed the meta-description audit despite descriptive text being placed in meta[name=title].
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique meta[name=description] matching the visible page.

findings.summary: Many crawlable links have no descriptive text
findings.evidence: The DOM probe counted 125 href-bearing links without visible text or an accessible label; axe confirmed link-name failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove template leftovers and give every retained link descriptive anchor text or an accessible name.

findings.summary: Share and structured metadata misrepresent the page
findings.evidence: og:image points to an unrelated Mothercare product path, og:type is product without matching visible product data, and one JSON-LD block is invalid.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish valid JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata that exactly matches the visible entity and canonical page.

findings.summary: HTTPS lacks baseline security headers
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Nearly the entire page load is third-party
findings.evidence: The HAR attributed 188 of 190 requests and 1.896MB of 1.897MB transferred bytes to third parties; tracker evidence found 22 third-party origins and five known trackers.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unrelated analytics/search/commerce vendors and load any necessary analytics only with data-minimised consent-aware configuration.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are absent
findings.evidence: No HSTS, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, or CSP frame-ancestors is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add browser policies at the final canonical response and verify them in report-only mode before enforcement.

findings.summary: Runtime depends on failing foreign-origin services
findings.evidence: Lighthouse records CORS failures for customer data and fonts, while the custom overlay uses an unfocusable span close rather than robust platform behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove/condition foreign dependencies and use robust semantic overlay primitives.

findings.summary: 404 recovery is a blank response
findings.evidence: The representative nonexistent URL returns HTTP 404 with no useful body, navigation, retry, or route back to the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve an accessible 404 page that explains the state and offers safe recovery links.

findings.summary: CSS is not writing-mode resilient
findings.evidence: html lang=id is correct, but the inline CSS probe counted 255 physical left/right declarations and zero logical inline/block declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain the correct language tag and replace directional layout properties with logical properties where layout direction matters.

findings.summary: The promotion uses pressure without adequate context
findings.evidence: A load-time modal pushes LOGIN/DAFTAR and advertises “RTP gacor” and minimum deposit/withdraw amounts while obscuring content and omitting responsible-gambling or odds context.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the forced promotion and present commitments, odds, eligibility, and safer-play information before any account action.

findings.summary: Commercial gambling commitments are not explained before hand-off
findings.evidence: The first viewport promotes deposits and withdrawals and routes LOGIN/DAFTAR to an external host without visible terms, operator identity, age gate, cancellation/self-exclusion, or responsible-gambling information.
findings.suggestedFix: Disclose operator identity, eligibility, terms, costs/odds, safer-play controls, and account reversal paths before the external hand-off.

findings.summary: Image delivery is wasteful
findings.evidence: The image audit found 15 oversized images, 40 legacy-format images, 27 missing dimensions, and 7 missing responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate correctly sized AVIF/WebP sources, srcset/sizes, and intrinsic dimensions.

findings.summary: Unrelated background code and requests dominate
findings.evidence: The page makes 190 requests and loads 129 scripts, including Magento customer, search, maps, sharing, analytics, and product modules unrelated to the landing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Delete irrelevant modules and defer the small set of value-bearing optional work until user intent.

findings.summary: Third-party budget is disproportionate
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 1.896MB and 188 requests; a single promo JPEG is 496KB and Google Maps adds 385KB despite no visible map in the first view.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a purpose-appropriate page budget and remove Maps, copied commerce assets, and nonessential trackers/media.

findings.summary: Memory footprint is excessive for a static landing page
findings.evidence: The baseline heap contains 406,474 nodes and 24.5MB self-size for a single static landing page, consistent with the oversized copied commerce runtime.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove irrelevant DOM/templates/scripts and verify the baseline node/heap footprint drops materially.

taskList.title: Remove the forced modal and rebuild the core hand-off as an honest, accessible flow
Delete the copied Mothercare/Magento runtime and unrelated third parties
Fix accessibility names, contrast, structure, and keyboard focus
Deploy baseline security and privacy response policies
Add preference-driven theme and reduced-motion handling
Add useful error and recovery states
